title: Dark Predictions Paintings — premium gallery + email purchase CTA + II-protected admin management

requirements.summary: Remove all auction/bidding UX from the frontend (routes, navigation, and copy) and ensure no public UI implies bidding or registration for bidding.
acceptanceCriteria: There is no auction/bidding section visible anywhere in the UI (no routes, menus, buttons, or labels).
Backend has no auction/bid-related types, state, or public methods.
No user registration flow for bidding exists.

file_operations.description: Create the application shell and routing for the gallery and admin areas only; ensure there are no routes, navigation links, buttons, or copy that reference auctions, bidding, or bidding registration.
Create a top navigation/header component that only links to the public gallery and (optionally) the admin area; ensure labels and UI copy do not mention auctions/bidding.
Implement the public gallery page copy and CTAs to focus on direct purchase/contact via email only; ensure no auction/bidding language appears.
Implement the painting detail page copy and CTAs to focus on direct purchase/contact via email only; ensure no auction/bidding language appears.

requirements.summary: Show a mailto purchase/contact CTA with the email offgridsecrets@gmail.com on all painting listing and detail views.
acceptanceCriteria: Every painting card and/or painting detail view displays "offgridsecrets@gmail.com" as the contact email for purchases.
The email is clickable and opens the user’s email client via a mailto: link.
User-facing text is in English and does not mention auctions/bidding.

file_operations.description: Add a shared constant for the purchase/admin contact email set to "offgridsecrets@gmail.com" and helper to build a mailto link.
Create a reusable purchase CTA component that displays "offgridsecrets@gmail.com" and links via mailto:. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Create painting card UI for the gallery list, including the ContactEmailCTA so the email appears on each listing card. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Ensure the detail view includes the ContactEmailCTA prominently and uses English, non-auction copy.

requirements.summary: Build the public gallery (home) and painting detail views for “Dark Predictions Paintings”, sourcing paintings from the backend and showing images, title, description, and price.
acceptanceCriteria: The site displays the title "Dark Predictions Paintings" prominently (e.g., header and browser title).
A public gallery view lists paintings pulled from the backend.
A painting detail view exists and shows title, description, price, and image(s).

file_operations.description: Confirm the browser title is "Dark Predictions Paintings" and keep the document language English.
Wire routes for the public gallery (home) and painting detail view; ensure the header prominently displays "Dark Predictions Paintings" and that navigation works end-to-end.
Add React Query hooks to fetch the public list of paintings via the backend actor (getAllPaintings) and manage loading/error states.
Add a React Query hook to fetch a single painting by id via the backend actor (getPainting) and manage loading/error states.
Render the gallery list sourced from the backend (getAllPaintings), including painting cards with image preview(s), title, and price, and link each card to the detail route.
Render painting title, description, price, and image(s) sourced from the backend (getPainting), plus the purchase contact email CTA.
Add helpers for formatting price (bigint) for display and any shared text formatting needed for the gallery/detail UI.

requirements.summary: Create an admin dashboard UI to add/edit/delete paintings (title, description, price, images) and display the admin contact email.
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can add a new painting with title, description, price, and at least one image.
Admin can edit title/description/price/images for an existing painting.
Admin can delete an existing painting.
The admin dashboard UI shows "offgridsecrets@gmail.com" (as a displayed contact/admin email).

file_operations.description: Create the admin dashboard page layout, show the admin contact email "offgridsecrets@gmail.com", list existing paintings, and provide create/edit/delete actions. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a form component to create/edit a painting with fields title, description, price, and image(s), including client-side validation and image upload UI using ExternalBlob. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Create an admin list/table view of paintings with edit/delete controls, reusing painting display patterns and showing image previews. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add React Query mutations for addPainting, updatePainting, and deletePainting with cache invalidation for the paintings list/detail; handle authorization errors gracefully.

Add helpers to convert browser File inputs to ExternalBlob (fromBytes) and to read direct image URLs (getDirectURL) for previews; use the blob-storage ExternalBlob capability for image handling. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Register the /admin route and wire navigation entry points so the admin dashboard is reachable (but guarded per REQ-6).

requirements.summary: Add a visible mission statement on the public site describing that proceeds support affordable modern housing for the local community.
acceptanceCriteria: A visible mission statement is present on the public site in English and clearly communicates the proceeds’ purpose.

file_operations.description: Create a mission statement section component with English copy stating that proceeds support building and developing affordable modern housing for the local community.
Place the MissionStatement section in a prominent location on the public gallery page (e.g., under hero/intro) while maintaining the premium gallery aesthetic.

requirements.summary: Protect the admin dashboard with Internet Identity login and admin authorization checks; no email-based authentication.
acceptanceCriteria: Admin routes/pages require Internet Identity login to access.
Non-admin users cannot call create/update/delete painting methods (backend enforces authorization).
The app does not implement email-based authentication, registration, verification, or emailing features.

file_operations.description: Create a login/logout button using the existing useInternetIdentity hook; on logout, clear cached React Query data. Use the authorization component guidance for login UX. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add a hook that checks authentication state and queries the backend actor (isCallerAdmin/getCallerUserRole) to determine admin access; expose loading/denied states and handle authorization traps gracefully.

Create a route guard wrapper that requires Internet Identity login and admin authorization to render admin pages; show an access denied screen otherwise. Use the authorization component guidance for access control UI. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a simple access-denied UI for non-admin users attempting to view the admin dashboard, with a clear login/logout action and no email-based auth messaging. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add the LoginButton to the global header and ensure the admin navigation entry routes through the AdminRouteGuard (no public access to admin UI).
Wrap the admin dashboard route with AdminRouteGuard so admin pages always require Internet Identity and admin authorization.

requirements.summary: Apply a cohesive premium noir gallery theme across public and admin pages, avoiding blue/purple as dominant brand colors, and wire required generated brand assets into the UI.
acceptanceCriteria: Public pages and admin pages share a consistent design system (colors, type scale, components).
Primary palette avoids blue/purple as the dominant brand colors.
Design feels gallery/premium and is consistently applied across navigation, cards, and forms.

file_operations.description: Create global styling with a dark editorial/noir design system using CSS variables compatible with Tailwind/shadcn tokens; avoid blue/purple as the dominant palette and apply consistent typography/spacing.
Adjust Tailwind theme extensions (fonts, radius, and token usage) to support the noir premium design system consistently across pages while avoiding a blue/purple primary.
Add the generated minimalist wordmark logo asset as a static public file at the exact path specified.
Add the generated abstract dark textured hero background asset as a static public file at the exact path specified.
Wire the generated wordmark image from frontend/public/assets/generated/dark-predictions-wordmark.dim_1200x300.png into the header branding and apply the shared premium theme styles.

Wire the generated hero background image from frontend/public/assets/generated/gallery-hero-texture.dim_2400x1350.png into the gallery hero/intro section and apply the shared premium theme styles to gallery cards and layout.

Apply the same design system (colors/type/components) to admin forms, lists, and dialogs so admin feels consistent with the public gallery theme. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
